description: Wasserschutzgebiete im Kreis Mettmann is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The water protection areas contain the zone boundaries of defined and planned drinking water and health spring protection areas (as well as some reserve or priority areas) on an overview scale. The data was provided by the Düsseldorf district government. Status in 2015. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Water protection areas in the district of Mettmann" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Heiligenhaus, Geoportal, Trinkwasserschutzzonen, WSG, Wasserschutzzonen, Erkrath. The listing shows 2015-08-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
